proof_decision.trust_question: Can shared context routing admit current authority only from the registered subsystem owner operation and reject marker-only, stale, forged, or duplicate evidence?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: Focused owner-dispatch, forged-result, canonical-structure, stale-generated, superseded-baseline, and duplicate-owner fixtures in the existing operating-decision suite.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Replace only when the context-authority registry generates equivalent per-owner executable conformance cases and negative admission proof.
proof_decision.residual_risk: Some owner operations remain adapters over package-private subsystem APIs until those packages expose dedicated public owner-result operations.
